25:21.text: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or
see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves

25:22.text: The day they see the angels
- no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and

25:23.text: what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.

25:24.text: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are
a better settlement and better resting place.

25:25.text: the Day when the heaven will split open with
and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.

25:26.text: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.

25:27.text: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands
he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.

25:28.text: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one

25:29.text: He led me away from the remembrance
after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."

25:30.text: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur’ān as

25:31.text: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.

25:32.text: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur’ān not revealed to him all at once?" Thus
that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.
